name: Multi-resolution Data Management
aliases: Multi-resolution Data Management — Flat blocking multi-resolution data management
definition: A data structure where the volume is divided into small blocks stored in a multi-resolution structure based on Level-of-Detail (LOD) rather than spatial location, to support large-scale volumes.
summary: Multi-resolution Data Management reduces computation and storage in volume rendering by packing blocks of varying resolutions into a single texture based on Level-of-Detail rather than spatial location.
